purpose: Validate local wwPDB MMseqs2 search, strict candidate filtering, entry metadata joining, comparable-resolution selection, and mmCIF coordinate coverage.
boundaries: The run is isolated from MCP and Dify.
The local data and outputs cannot be used as a research conclusion or production candidate.
